name: first_battle_save
description: From boot (new_game's steps) through the registration and the Asuka lobby to the story's first battle (scripted, map 0x200 at progress 3), won with CROSS on every menu; then a save at the Asuka Inn (map 0x20A, STGMCARD), a hard reset and Continue to load it. One script: the save point is only reachable through the battle's story path. Waits are on game state (stage, map, progress, memory card state) or player position (walk), so it holds on both CPU cores. Then, from the loaded save, the Asuka Item Shop (map 0x20D, STITSHOP shop 2): four Power Charges bought with the quantity capped by money (50 BIT -> 2), a purchase refused for lack of money, back to the field. The shop is appended after the load so every earlier checkpoint stays as it was. Then a tour of the other menus reachable from boot: the lab's Digimon chart (STGDGLAB, map 0x206), the inn's stairs to maps 0x20B and 0x201 and the card arena (0x211), whose introduction gives the card case (item 0x192); with it the field menu's party page opens the card album (STCRDABM) and the deck editor (STCRDDEK) through STSTATUS, and the arena's counter becomes the card shop (STCRDSHP: Buy opened, nothing affordable). Then STGTRAIN: from the arena through the inn and Asuka City to map 0x21D (an encounter area, crossed before encounter_timer runs out) and its trainer; the party has no TP, so a training is refused ("Not enough TP."), and the script leaves.

then CROSS, TRIANGLE, CROSS, TRIANGLE, 92 frames apart, which ends on the training choice from either screen: the warning takes only CROSS (it closes), every other screen goes back on TRIANGLE
